scripts.build: npm run sync-core && npm run build -w packages/vscode
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/core && tsc -p packages/mod --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w packages/vscode
scripts.test: npm test -w packages/core && node scripts/mod-check.mjs test && npm test -w packages/vscode
scripts.verify: node scripts/sync-core.mjs --check && node scripts/check-marketplace.mjs && npm run typecheck && node scripts/mod-check.mjs validate && npm test
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package -w packages/vscode
scripts.install-local: npm run build && npm run install-local -w packages/vscode
